situations.title: 음주력·마지막 음주 문진
situations.tagline: Yeah I drink… I don't know, does it really matter how much?
situations.brief: 음주량·빈도·마지막 음주 시각을 비판단적으로 문진하세요.
keyPhrases: It helps me care for you to know how much you usually drink.
When was your last drink? That tells us what to watch for.
I'm not here to judge — this is just about keeping you safe.

situations.title: 금단 초기 증상 사정
situations.tagline: My hands won't stop shaking and I'm sweating like crazy since this morning.
situations.brief: 떨림·발한을 사정하고 CIWA 척도의 목적을 소개하세요.
keyPhrases: The shaking and sweating are early signs of alcohol withdrawal.
We'll use a checklist called CIWA to track how you're doing.
When did you have your last drink?

situations.title: CIWA 척도 설명
situations.tagline: You keep coming back to ask me the same questions — why?
situations.brief: CIWA의 반복 사정 목적과 협조 필요성을 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: I check on you often so we catch any worsening early.
Each time I ask about shaking, sweating, and how you feel.
Your honest answers help us give you the right amount of medicine.

situations.title: 티아민 투여 설명
situations.tagline: What's this shot for? I just came in for the shakes.
situations.brief: 티아민의 목적과 포도당 전 투여 원칙을 알기 쉽게 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: This vitamin, thiamine, protects your brain and nerves.
We give it before any sugar to prevent a serious problem.
It's common and important for people who drink regularly.

situations.title: 만취 관찰 환자
situations.tagline: I'm fiiine… lemme just… sleep it off, okay?
situations.brief: 기도·낙상 위험을 사정하고 반복 재사정 필요성을 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm going to keep the head of your bed up to protect your breathing.
Please stay in bed — I don't want you to fall.
I'll be checking on you often to make sure you're okay.

situations.title: 중등도 금단
situations.tagline: The shaking is getting worse and I feel like bugs are crawling on me.
situations.brief: CIWA 점수를 기반으로 벤조 적정 투여를 시행·설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Your withdrawal score is high, so I'm giving you medication to calm it.
We adjust the dose based on how you're doing each time I check.
Tell me if you see or feel things that aren't there.

situations.title: 금단 발작
situations.tagline: What happened? I feel so out of it…
situations.brief: 발작 후 상태를 사정하고 재발 위험 감시를 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: You had a seizure from the withdrawal — you're safe now.
We'll watch closely because another one can happen.
I'm keeping the rails up and staying nearby to protect you.

situations.title: 알코올성 환각증
situations.tagline: There are spiders all over the wall — can't you see them?
situations.brief: 환시·환청을 사정하고 현실감을 유지하도록 안전하게 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: I know they look real to you, but I don't see spiders — you're safe.
This can happen with withdrawal, and medication will help.
Focus on my voice — you're in the hospital and I'm right here.

situations.title: 베르니케 의심
situations.tagline: He's confused, his eyes keep jerking, and he can barely walk straight.
situations.brief: 안구운동·실조·혼돈 삼징을 인지하고 즉시 티아민을 투여하세요.
keyPhrases: The eye movements, confusion, and unsteady walk point to a thiamine deficiency.
We're giving high-dose thiamine right away to prevent lasting damage.
How long has he been confused, and has he been eating?

situations.title: 만성 음주 전해질 이상
situations.tagline: I feel so weak and my heart's been fluttering — I haven't eaten much in days.
situations.brief: 저마그네슘·저칼륨 위험을 사정하고 보정 계획을 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Heavy drinking can drop your magnesium and potassium, causing that fluttering.
We'll check your levels and replace what's low through your IV.
We're watching your heart rhythm while we correct these.

situations.title: 금단+외상
situations.tagline: I fell last night when I was shaking — but really, it's just a bruise.
situations.brief: 은폐된 외상 손상을 탐색하며 금단 관리를 병행하세요.
keyPhrases: A fall while shaking can cause injuries you might not feel yet.
I want to check your head and body carefully to be safe.
Did you hit your head, and do you remember the fall clearly?

situations.title: 반복 재원 환자
situations.tagline: You again? Look, I know the drill — just give me something and let me go.
situations.brief: 관계를 형성하고 지역 자원 연계를 비판단적으로 제안하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm glad you came in — let's take care of you properly today.
When you're ready, I can connect you with people who can help.
No pressure — but that door is always open when you want it.

situations.title: 알코올성 간질환 동반
situations.tagline: My belly's swollen and my skin's gone yellow — and now the shakes started.
situations.brief: 응고·복수·황달을 사정하며 금단 관리를 병행·설명하세요.
keyPhrases: The yellow skin and swelling suggest your liver is struggling.
That also raises your bleeding risk, so we'll be careful.
We'll manage the withdrawal while we support your liver.

situations.title: 금단+정신질환
situations.tagline: I stopped my psych meds when I started drinking again — now everything's spinning out.
situations.brief: 이중진단을 고려해 안전을 확보하며 협진을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: We'll treat both the withdrawal and your mental health together.
Are you having any thoughts of hurting yourself right now?
A psychiatry team will help us make a safe plan for you.

situations.title: 음주 부인 환자
situations.tagline: I barely drink at all — I have no idea why I'm shaking like this.
situations.brief: 객관적 징후로 금단 가능성을 예측하며 비판단적으로 접근하세요.
keyPhrases: Your tremor and sweating can happen when the body misses alcohol.
Whatever the amount, we just want to keep you comfortable and safe.
Have you noticed feeling like this in the mornings before?

situations.title: 진전섬망
situations.tagline: Get away from me! Who are all these people?!
situations.brief: 자율신경 폭풍을 인지하고 집중 진정 계획을 SBAR로 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: He's in delirium tremens — hypertensive, tachycardic, and severely agitated.
He needs aggressive benzodiazepine sedation and one-to-one safety.
CIWA is off the scale — I need a physician and possibly ICU now.

situations.title: 불응성 금단 발작 중첩
situations.tagline: He's seizing again — that's the third one, and it won't stop.
situations.brief: 고용량 벤조를 시행하고 기도를 관리하며 팀을 지휘하세요.
keyPhrases: He's in status — give another dose of benzodiazepine now.
Protect the airway and get suction and oxygen ready.
If this doesn't break, we escalate and prepare to intubate.

situations.title: 베르니케-코르사코프 진행
situations.tagline: He can't remember anything new and keeps making up stories now.
situations.brief: 비가역 진행 위험을 설명하고 긴급 티아민 투여를 시행하세요.
keyPhrases: The memory loss and made-up stories suggest the deficiency has advanced.
We're giving urgent high-dose thiamine, though some damage may be lasting.
How long has his memory been like this?

situations.title: 금단+패혈증 감별
situations.tagline: I've got the shakes and a fever — I feel really, really sick this time.
situations.brief: 발열·빈맥의 원인이 감염인지 감별하며 감염원을 탐색하세요.
keyPhrases: A fever with the shakes could mean an infection, not just withdrawal.
We're looking for a source and drawing blood cultures.
Have you had a cough, burning urine, or any pain anywhere?

situations.title: DT 심혈관 위기
situations.tagline: His heart rate and pressure are through the roof and climbing.
situations.brief: 빈맥·고혈압 급변에 대응하며 진정과 감시를 강화하세요.
keyPhrases: The autonomic surge is spiking his heart rate and pressure dangerously.
We're increasing sedation to control the storm.
Keep him on continuous monitoring and call the physician back in.

situations.title: 중증 금단 야간 급변 인계
situations.tagline: His CIWA's been climbing all night despite the doses I've given.
situations.brief: CIWA와 투약 추이를 정리해 담당 의료진에게 SBAR로 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: Severe withdrawal, CIWA climbed from twelve to twenty-two overnight.
He's had three benzo doses with minimal response.
He's now hallucinating and tremulous — I need him reassessed now.
